content.rendered:
She’s much better known as an actress, but Minnie Driver’s also a singer-songwriter with three albums under her belt.

Minnie released her first album, Everything I’ve Got in My Pocket, in 2004. Accompanying the ten original compositions on that album is a lovely cover of Bruce’s “Hungry Heart.”

The arrangement is lovely: all slow, soft piano and drum brush. I can’t honestly say it suits the lyrics, but then again, neither does Bruce’s original arrangement, so no stones thrown from where I sit.

Take a listen below.

© July 25, 2019

excerpt.rendered: Minnie Driver’s cover of “Hungry Heart” is more lush and romantic than Bruce’s lyrics call for, but then again so was Bruce’s original arrangement. Take a listen to her lovely version inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, River City Extension: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Start your morning off with a cool groove: watch River City Extension put their unique spin on Bruce's "Hungry Heart."

jetpack-related-posts.title: The Mavericks: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: From their latest album, check out The Mavericks' country-ska take on Bruce's "Hungry Heart."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Head and The Heart: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: At a special tribute radio show on the occasion of Bruce's 70th birthday, Springsteen fans The Head and The Heart closed the show with their lovely cover of "Hungry Heart."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Spare Parts: Mike Love and The Beach Boys: Getcha Hungry Heart Back
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Beach Boys' 1985 single was an even better "Hungry Heart" cover than Mike Love's direct attempt, and they make for a terrific mash-up.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Bleachers: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Jack Antonoff delivered a beautifully poignant cover of Bruce's poppy hit single in a 2017 radio appearance on The Bruce Brunch.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, HouseHolder Reloaded: The Wayfarer
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Our final Cover Me entry before our month-long hiatus is Boss-approved! Check out this lovely arrangement of a Western Stars deep cut.
